Veteran Owned, Chesterfield Grown

After 12 years in the army as a welder fabricator, I’ve started my own maintenance business—bringing military-grade precision and pride to local homes and businesses. It’s more than just work; it’s my way of giving back to the community that shaped me, with honest, reliable service rooted in strong values.
